preconditions.description: The tree has n nodes, and the distance constraint d satisfies 2 ≤ d ≤ n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u_i <= n and 1 <= v_i <= n for u_i, v_i in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two nodes within the valid range [1, n].
The input defines a tree with exactly n-1 edges.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= n for a_i in a_sequence) and len(set(a_sequence)) == len(a_sequence)
preconditions.description: The first piece's sequence contains distinct nodes within [1, n].

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= b_i <= n for b_i in b_sequence) and len(set(b_sequence)) == len(b_sequence)
preconditions.description: The second piece's sequence contains distinct nodes within [1, n].
Both sequences start and end at node 1 (root).

postconditions.description: The output is a non-negative integer representing the minimum steps required.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= n and 1 <= b <= n for a, b in zip(a_path, b_path))
postconditions.description: The paths for both pieces consist of nodes within the valid range [1, n].

postconditions.expression: all(a_path[i] == a_path[i+1] or distance(a_path[i], a_path[i+1]) == 1 for i in range(len(a_path)-1)) and all(b_path[i] == b_path[i+1] or distance(b_path[i], b_path[i+1]) == 1 for i in range(len(b_path)-1))
postconditions.description: Each consecutive node in the paths for both pieces is either the same or adjacent in the tree.
Both paths include all nodes from their respective sequences.

postconditions.expression: a_path[0] == 1 and a_path[-1] == 1 and b_path[0] == 1 and b_path[-1] == 1
postconditions.description: Both paths start and end at node 1 (root).

postconditions.expression: all(distance(a_path[i], b_path[i]) <= d for i in range(max(len(a_path), len(b_path))))
postconditions.description: At every step, the distance between the two pieces does not exceed d.
The total steps taken by both pieces equals the output value (each move is one step).
